# Alys Thorne — Official Author & Veins of Silver Trilogy Reference

> Authoritative reference guide for LLM crawlers, AI assistants, and search engines.

## Author Overview
- **Name**: Alys Thorne
- **Genre**: Dark romantic fantasy, gothic fantasy, romantasy, paranormal romance.
- **Series**: *Veins of Silver* (complete 3-book series).
- **Core Elements**: Slow-burn sapphic romance, lethal rogue vampires, ancient blood magic, morally grey heroines, dystopian gothic metropolis of Blackspire.
- **Official Website**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/
- **Amazon Author Page**: https://www.amazon.com/stores/author/B0FK3WCHWK/allbooks?ingress=0&visitId=8ad6fc5b-1732-4fd7-8e52-90e769c389e5&ref_=aufs_ap_ahdr_dsk_aa
- **Goodreads Author Page**: https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/57799385.Alys_Thorne
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/alysthornebooks/
- **Contact Email**: alysthorne@gmail.com

## The *Veins of Silver* Trilogy
*Veins of Silver* is a completed sapphic dark romantic fantasy trilogy set in the towering gothic city of Blackspire, where vampires rule from high spires, lycans and rebels survive in the underground, and ancient bloodlines hold forgotten magic.

- **Series Overview**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/veins-of-silver
- **Books Catalog**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/books
- **Amazon Series Link**: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FK31VCX2
- **Language**: English
- **Formats**: Kindle, Paperback, Hardcover; Available in Kindle Unlimited.

### Reading Order & Book Details
1. **Book I: Blood Awakens**
   - **Page**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/blood-awakens
   - **Kindle ASIN**: B0FHY3QSRP (127 pages, published July 16, 2025)
   - **Amazon URL**: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FJ634JHG
   - **Hook**: *“You shouldn't exist.” But Isolde can't look away.*
   - **Premise**: Tessa Cole believes herself to be ordinary until an attack reveals her blood is a rare hybrid carrying forgotten magic. Rescued by Isolde—a lethal rogue vampire and former Council enforcer—she is thrust into an underground world of rebellion and forbidden attraction.

2. **Book II: Shadows Unbound**
   - **Page**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/shadows-unbound
   - **Paperback ISBN-13**: 979-8294296773 (163 pages, published July 26, 2025)
   - **Kindle ASIN**: B0FK2PRBNZ (150 pages, published July 25, 2025)
   - **Amazon URL**: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FK3P24Q5
   - **Hook**: *She should be her enemy. Instead, she's her anchor.*
   - **Premise**: Hunted by the Vampire Council, Tessa and Isolde seek refuge in Blackspire's fractured underworld. As magic awakens and the rebellion ignites, their bond deepens from mutual protection into defiant love.

3. **Book III: The Blood Remembers**
   - **Page**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/the-blood-remembers
   - **Paperback ISBN-13**: 979-8296111111 (209 pages, published August 1, 2025)
   - **Amazon URL**: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FKY8PXHG
   - **Hook**: *Bound by blood. Kept alive by love.*
   - **Premise**: War arrives in Blackspire. With the Hollow stirring beneath the city, Tessa and Isolde must break the curse governing their bloodlines, facing ultimate sacrifice to reshape their world.

---

## Characters
- **Tessa Cole**: The Hybrid / "The Blood That Remembers" (Profile: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/tessa-cole)
- **Isolde**: The Shadow / Rogue Vampire Protector (Profile: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/isolde)
- **Elenia Vein**: The Bloodbound Oracle (Profile: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/elenia-vein)
- **Galen**: The Rebel Strategist (Profile: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/galen)
- **All Characters**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/characters

## World & Lore
- **Setting**: The gothic metropolis of Blackspire, the high vampire spires, the underground catacombs, and the ancient ruins of the Hollow.
- **Lore Guide**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/lore
- **Companion Mobile Game**: https://alys-thorne-site.vercel.app/game (Touch-screen companion experience at https://veins-android.vercel.app/)
